name: easypws
description: Easy Price Watch Service — self-hosted multi-retailer price monitoring platform

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' run build && pnpm --filter @easypws/web build && pnpm --filter @easypws/api build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @easypws/adapters test && pnpm --filter @easypws/rules test && pnpm --filter @easypws/database test && pnpm --filter @easypws/services test
